description: Deterministic, category-balanced selection of 100 distinct news texts from the 200 historical evaluation records (data/test_samples.jsonl[5:205]).
method: Iterate the 200 evaluation records in their stored file order; skip any record whose exact text was already selected; accept a record while its category quota is not yet filled. Quotas: 100 = 7 x 14 + 2, so the two alphabetically first categories (dunya, ekonomi) get 15 and the other five get 14. Implemented by select_evaluation_ids() in src/evaluate.py; no randomness, no model output used.
